title: Incomplete inline-four CAD studies: baseline004 and candidate001

experiment.prompt: Design a small machinable inline-four engine assembly with a hand-turnable crankshaft, camshaft, pistons, rods, bearings, lubrication paths and removable service covers. Keep the assembled envelope within X 200, Y 120, Z 160 mm, with cylinders in a row along X and their axes along Z. Use a machinable aluminum block and steel shafts with replaceable bronze bushings; choose the remaining dimensions for a desktop mechanical prototype. Use conventional milling, turning and drilling. No combustion qualification is requested.
experiment.comparison_scope: Matched prompt and request controls; different software and fresh stochastic interpretations. Descriptive observations only, not a causal speed or reliability estimate.

candidate001.source_role: later immutable software candidate; not the subsequent reporting repair

timing_scope.project_elapsed: Project creation to attempt_finished journal timestamp. Both runs use the same boundary definition, including final readback and journal-tail work after first observed terminal state; pre-project qualification is excluded.
timing_scope.model_time: Sum of recorded model-call durations; distinct from total project elapsed.
timing_scope.other_clocks: Adapter observation and benchmark wall values have separate start/stop boundaries. Do not subtract unlike clocks as exact overhead.
timing_scope.candidate_clock_clarification: First valid CAD was saved 441.201 seconds after project creation. Adapter first-CAD observation 499.922 seconds and attempt-journal first-CAD 504.775 seconds use different origins.
timing_scope.speed_claim: None. One observed run per condition cannot attribute speed differences to the repairs; summed model time increased despite fewer calls.

remaining_engineering_gaps: Matching connecting-rod caps and cap fasteners remain absent in the candidate audit.
Positive shaft/wrist-pin retention and bushing anti-rotation are not fully modeled or proved.
A modeled crankshaft-to-camshaft timing connection remains missing.
No exact-revision coupled mechanism solve or required multi-pose cycle evidence is present.
Lubrication continuity, practical machining, tolerance stacks, assembly access and service removal remain unverified.
Physical hand-turnability, strength, durability, lubrication adequacy and manufacture are not qualified.
reporting_repair_scope: The original candidate proof endpoint was unavailable because its 18 unsupported + 3 scalar contract missed the final-status gate. A later regression-tested repair produces a complete 21-result report in saved-byte fixtures, retaining 18 unknowns. It does not retroactively change either original run or prove missing engineering duties.
evidence_scope: Saved-byte audits verified delivered package/selected-artifact identities and recorded measurements. This comparison performs no new native measurement or model call. No full-task PASS is established in either run.
